_name: Error — approve POST returned non-ok with reason='invoice_update_failed'; inline red role='alert' shows the localized applyError ('We couldn't update the invoice — nothing was changed…'), buttons re-enabled for retry.

_signals.error: We couldn't update the invoice — nothing was changed. Please try again or contact your contractor.

_note: The raw backend reason 'invoice_update_failed' is mapped to the friendly applyError string — the raw token is never shown to the homeowner. Other reasons surface as-is; missing reason falls back to submitError 'Couldn't submit ({status})'. After error, busy resets to null so both buttons are clickable again.
